intro: A smaller force can still dictate the battle when it chooses where the battle begins. GUERRILLA HUNTER - 2 JUL 1941 places your command at HQ 8th NKVD Rife Brigade, Estonia. HQ 8th NKVD Rife Brigade, Estonia CO General Kuznetsov It does not look good for us, Comrade! The Germans stand at the Estonian border and all over crawled Bandits out of their holes. The wider stakes are clear: A serious defeat for the Estonian bandits and their Finnish friends. A strong result opens the road to BLITZ - 10 JUL 1941. Your victory will be measured in disrupted movement, captured supplies, and fighters who live to strike again.
